item.title: 1: [1.1+1.4] Netmiko and Ansible
item.text:
For this lablet, complete the network automation workflow that deploys switch VLAN settings and router ACL, interface description, OSPF, loopback, and NTP changes. The current run fails because required values in the automation files are incomplete. Search all.yml and py_deploy.py for sections marked #TODO these are the only sections that must be modified to make the automation and post-validation pass.

Workstation Credentials: username:cisco, password:cisco

Task 1: Open the all.yml file in the Desktop/tasks/ansible/group_vars/ folder and complete the #TODO section in the code.

Task 2: After completing the #TODO values in all.yml, go to the Desktop/tasks/ansible/ directory and run ./run-playbook.sh to push the configuration.

Task 3: Open the py_deploy.py file in the Desktop/tasks/scripts folder and complete the two #TODO section in the code.

Task 4: After completing the #TODO values in py_deploy.py, go to the Desktop/tasks/scripts directory and run python py_deploy.py, and confirm deployment messages are successful.

Task 5: Confirm that the devices have been configured. You can achieve this by staying in Desktop/tasks/scripts/ and running python post_validate.py (expected result: OK)
